industry: Electric road systems and charging infrastructure
summary: Företag 9 develops conductive electric road technology that enables charging of electric vehicles while driving and when parked. The company focuses on reducing battery requirements and accelerating transport electrification.
target_market: Global electric transport and charging infrastructure market
strategy_notes: Focused on commercial deployment of electric road infrastructure through pilot projects and partnerships with infrastructure and transport stakeholders.
technology_notes: Uses conductive rail-based charging technology embedded in road surfaces to deliver electricity directly to vehicles.
risk_notes: Dependent on infrastructure investment cycles, regulatory support, large-scale deployment adoption and competition from alternative charging technologies.
